successors.name: Kingdom of Nagpur
successors.text: large parts of the Vidarbha region and parts of southern Madhya Pradesh (modern Chhindwara, Nagpur, Seoni and Betul districts)

ledger.x: 1580: Jatba founds the Gond dynasty of Deogarh, deposing the Gauli princes Ransur and Ghansur.
1686: Bakht Buland Shah regains rule under Mughal suzerainty; rule spreads over large parts of Vidarbha and southern Madhya Pradesh.
1743: Raghoji I Bhonsle makes Burhan Shah a state pensioner; real power passes to the Bhonsles.
1743: the Gond kings lose real power; the page records no later history.

certainty.note: The page names no districts, rivers or boundaries; extents are modern districts.
